sensors.confirm_turn_off: Turn this plug off? Make sure you know what it's powering.
sensors.power_budget_note: {available} kW safe indefinitely · up to {trip} kW tolerated briefly · breaker trips quickly above that

climate.mode_note: Shared by both zones - one central plant sends either hot or cold water to both valves.
climate.no_target: No target set for this hour
climate.schedule_hint: Pick a temperature, then click or drag across hours to paint it. Changes save automatically.
climate.cooling_excluded_note: {count} zone(s) hidden here while cooling - their radiant panels can't be cooled safely (condensation risk). Still active in heating mode.
climate.away_note: Turns every valve off for a while without touching the weekly schedule - it resumes on its own once the period ends.
climate.away_idle: Not in away mode - the normal schedule is running.
climate.low_battery_message: "{name}"'s sensor battery is below {threshold}% ({value}%) - replace it soon.

climate_admin.intro: Map the two climate zones onto this apartment's own Shelly devices - only device ids change between installs, nothing else. Changes here need a LocalHome restart to take effect.
climate_admin.broker_note: Edited by hand in config/mqtt_broker.json, not through this page - see docs/integrations/mqtt.md.
climate_admin.broker_down_hint: check that mosquitto is actually running on that host - if it is, every zone below will keep saying "not reachable" no matter what's changed on the device side.
climate_admin.zones_note: Exactly two zones. Pick a sensor source per zone: a real Shelly device, a simulated one (no hardware installed yet), or a manual value for debugging the control logic. Switching a zone away from "Shelly" only stops LocalHome from reading that sensor - it never sends anything to the real device.
climate_admin.cool_enabled_label: Can be cooled (uncheck for a condensation-prone zone)
climate_admin.save_success: Saved - restart LocalHome, then reload this page to verify.
climate_admin.status_note: Reflects whichever mapping is currently running (the last restart), not unsaved edits above.
climate_admin.not_reachable_battery: Not reachable yet - battery sensors only report on their own wake cycle or a button press. Press the button on the device for an immediate test report.
climate_admin.not_reachable_offline: Was reporting, now unreachable - check the device is powered and in range.
climate_admin.valve_not_reachable: Not reachable - check the device id and that it's powered and connected to the broker.
climate_admin.manual_no_value: No manual value set yet - enter one below.
